module_interface.input: One frozen span plus aligned system and microphone PCM for exactly that span.
invariants: At most one bounded arbiter item per frozen span.
Within that item, active lanes decode serially; no second worker or fairness bypass.
Local speaker labels are namespaced by lane before stable time ordering.
Overlaps are preserved; no clipping, deduplication, or forced turn order.
Identity embeds each local speaker only from the PCM lane that produced it.
module_interface.output: One merged timed transcript, per-lane source trace, aggregate decode diagnostics, and lane-specific PCM ownership for every local speaker.

scope: Prototype only. The inputs are synthetic 15.377 dB lane disparities. Even a passing result requires fresh real attended evidence before production use.
